description: This file contains functions and logic for managing custom instructions, loading rule files, agent rules, and handling file system interactions within a project. It includes mechanisms for reading files, resolving symlinks, and assembling instructions and rules for prompts.

methods.name: safeReadFile
methods.description: Reads a file safely, trimming its content, and handling errors for non-existent files.

methods.name: directoryExists
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists at the given path.

methods.name: resolveDirectoryEntry
methods.description: Recursively resolves directory entries, handling symlinks and collecting file paths.

methods.name: resolveSymLink
methods.description: Resolves a symbolic link to its target, handling nested symlinks and directories.

methods.name: readTextFilesFromDirectory
methods.description: Reads all text files from a directory in alphabetical order, resolving symlinks and filtering binary files.

methods.name: formatDirectoryContent
methods.description: Formats multiple files' contents with relative paths as headers.

methods.name: loadRuleFiles
methods.description: Loads rule files from global, project-local, and subfolder directories, with fallback to legacy files.

methods.name: loadAgentRulesFileFromDirectory
methods.description: Loads agent rules from a specific directory, handling symlinks and optional path display.

methods.name: loadAgentRulesFile
methods.description: Loads agent rules from the project root directory.

methods.name: loadAllAgentRulesFiles
methods.description: Loads all agent rules files from root and subdirectories with .roo folders.

methods.name: addCustomInstructions
methods.description: Assembles custom instructions, rules, and agent rules into a prompt string, with support for toggles and settings.

methods.name: shouldIncludeRuleFile
methods.description: Determines if a file should be included in rule processing, filtering out cache and system files.
